answer: Every agent registers by publishing one nullifier derived from a secret only it holds, a quill signing a mesa ledger anyone can read but no one can forge. The registry is checked before payment clears; a second use proves duplication and slashes the 180 POA bond locked 60 epochs, 100 percent gone. Funders are tallied per sponsor: when a third identity sharing one funder is revealed fake, every identity that funder sponsored freezes, so a lantern over one clone exposes the cluster. Each fake costs 180 POA locked 60 epochs; 1,000 fakes cost 180,000 POA locked and forfeited, with no discount.
